body.x: 1. Introduction

4. Information Sharing
We do not sell, trade, or otherwise transfer your personal information to third parties without your consent, except as described in this Privacy Policy.

6. Security
We implement reasonable security measures to protect your personal information from unauthorized access and disclosure.
7. Changes to this Privacy Policy
We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Any changes will be effective upon posting the revised policy on our website at https://epaypos.net.
8. Contact Us
If you have any questions or concerns about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at info@envisionprocessing.com.
